name: Bifrost
short: High-performance open-source (Apache 2.0) Go AI gateway with drop-in OpenAI compatibility, virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, caching, fallbacks, and MCP gateway — self-hosted.

plans.name: OSS (Free Forever)
plans.notes: Self-hosted via Docker/K8s/Go binary: drop-in replacement, OTel-compatible, metrics and traces, budget management and rate limits with virtual keys, custom routing, caching, fallbacks, MCP gateway, prompt repository.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Everything in OSS plus guardrails, cluster mode, adaptive load balancing, SSO/SAML/OIDC, Vault support, RBAC, audit logs, log exports, VPC/on-prem/air-gapped deployment, SLA-backed support.
